summary: Opera's mindfulness-first browser for Windows and macOS: break reminders, guided breathing, binaural Boosts, no shortcuts or notifications by default, AI off by default.
bestFor: People who want a calmer, focus-oriented browser
Opera users who want fewer distractions
notFor: Users wanting open source or strongest privacy
Those who need ARM Windows support

pros.title: Take a Break
pros.detail: Guided breathing, stretches and meditation built in.

pros.title: Quiet defaults
pros.detail: No ads or notifications on first launch; AI off by default.

pros.title: Opera features
pros.detail: Free VPN, ad blocker and Aria are included.

pros.title: Chromium compatibility
pros.detail: Same site compatibility and extension support as Opera.

cons.title: Opera ownership
cons.detail: Same Kunlun majority ownership as Opera.

faq.a: Windows 10+ and macOS (macOS 12 per one guide, 13 per Wikipedia); no Linux or mobile.
Disabled by default, per an October 2026 review.

timeline.event: Opera Air released as a mindfulness-focused browser
Redesign with breathing modes: Destress, Refresh, Box Breathing, Relax
